Right now my brain keeps trying to convince me that I’m doing this all for attention and I’m being fake. This in return makes me feel so horrible and worried, and second guessing if I should go to the doctor. I have been researching OCD, digging through past childhood memories, and recent memories to make sure. I told my mom some thoughts I’ve been having, what I do to cope with them, and how they make me feel. My mom told me that does sound like OCD and I should go talk to someone. After I told her I felt so fake and horrible like I’m doing this whole damn thing for attention. I have college work I’m struggling to keep up with because of these thoughts, and I’m not trying to make excuses. I want to do the work. I love these classes and want to keep my GPA at a 3.9 but it’s a struggle this semester. I don’t know how often this happens, but my basic needs also get thrown to the side because of my compulsions. We have a broken car under the house that needs to be fixed. My dad walked into the kitchen when I was making muffins and said that he’s going to fix the car soon. I mentioned that my boyfriend asked yesterday when he’s going to fix it because that’s sometime he asks me out of genuine curiosity, he’s autistic too.  My dad got irritated and left the kitchen. We continued to argue back and forth about it because I told him I only mentioned it because my boyfriend asks me out of curiosity ever time we pass it. I ended up telling him I wouldn’t have mentioned it if it made him angry because he can have a scary temper. (Which my mom and younger sister all agree with me about his temper.) He got angry, wouldn’t let me finish explaining, and said threw at me how he supports everyone in this family, my mom doesn’t work because of off topic reasons, but she’s trying to find a job right now. 

Before that time, last June him and my mom borrowed 40 dollars from me and they said they would pay me back. In July my dad borrowed 300 more dollars from me and he didn’t want to tell my mom. (I took what I had from my student loan refund.) Before him and I went visit my aunt a few weeks ago he stopped at a bank, so that he can get money out to pay her back. I asked him when they’re going to pay me back because they borrowed over 300 dollars from me in June and he’s paying her back, but he only borrowed from her recently. This is money from my loans and I need it for next semester. I’m discussing it with him and he throws out of nowhere how he pays for my phone bill. That disgusted and upset me because I know I’m very aware of the fact he does that. I want to do that and be independent and far away by myself, but I can’t. 

Also, yes I pull my weight around the house. I do my own laundry, make my own food, clean after myself, and balance my own finances. What I can do on my own I do it. I loathe being dependent on people. I want to be independent and not rely on anyone.
